portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL8.10 - zkey: Fix CCA host version detection for newer CCA versions (s390utils/s390-tools) (JIRA:RHEL-105487)

*  zkey EKMFWeb plugin uses RSA-PSS unconditionally when generating certificates (JIRA:RHEL-114130)
